Bankar, Drug Inspector, had lodged the FIR alleging  that one of the patients at Saifee Hospital at Charni  Road, had expired because of administration of  spurious injection.

It was revealed that the  Applicants were some of the Distributors who had  supplied the said drug to Saifee Hospital. The records  reveal that the said drug was manufactured by M/s.
 Emcure Company and was distributed to five other  distributors who had in turn distributed the drug to  Shree Siddhivinayak Pharmaceuticals.
Learned APP  submits that Emcure Company sold the drug at  Rs..2296/- and the five other distributors had sold the  same to the Applicants at Rs.2339/-.
He submits that  the Applicants had sold the drug to Vardhaman  Distributors at Rs.1860/-, and to Galaxy Star Pharma  Distributor at Rs.1809/-, which was below the  purchase price.
It is to be noted that the crime was  registered on 07.01.2023.
Till date the Investigating  Agency had not taken steps to secure presence of the  Applicant to interrogate him on this aspect.
Apart  from the Applicant there are several other  distributors had also supplied the said drug to Saifee  Hospital.
Under the circumstances,this would be a fit  case to grant interim bail to the Applicant.

4. In ABA No.2320 of 2023 this Court was persuaded to grant Sandeep Ramdas Varpe And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177245193/
2 interim bail on 30th August, 2023 recording, inter alia, as under:-

sentences.text: 3] The applicant is the proprietor of M/s.Golu  Pharma.
It is alleged that the drug supplied by  the applicant i.e. Orofer FCM injection led to the  death of a patient at Saifee Hospital, on account  of adverse drug reaction.

4] The learned counsel for the applicant  submits that in the first information report  itself the first informant has referred to a  number of distributors by whom the said drug  came to be supplied through the sub-  distributors and eventually found place in the  store of Saifee Hospital.
There is no material to  show that the drug which caused reaction and  consequent death of the patient, was supplied  by the applicant.

It was submitted that the  applicant in turn has purchased the above Vishal Parekar   ::: Uploaded on - 19/08/2024 ::: Downloaded on - 23/08/2024 14:

The  learned counsel submitted that this Court has  granted relief to the co-accused who have been  implicated along with the applicant, in ABA Nos.
 250 of 2023 and 345 of 2023.
5] The learned APP submitted that Pradip  Agrawal, the arrested accused disclosed that  the injections in question were supplied by the  applicant.
6] The first information report itself indicates  that the drugs were supplied to the store of  Saifee Hospital by various suppliers.
The  question as to whether the particular drug  which led to adverse drug reaction originated  from the applicant
is a matter for investigation.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicants submit that the applicants have appeared before the investigating officer and rendered the necessary cooperation.

6. The observations in paragraph No. 6 of the aforesaid order dated 13th August, 2023 record that the question as to whether the particular drug that led to the adverse drug reaction originated from the applicant is a matter for investigation.
Indeed, that would be a matter for adjudication at the trial.
In the FIR, as many as 12 persons/entities, who allegedly manufactured, distributed or otherwise handled the drug have been implicated as accused.
7. In the backdrop of the nature of the accusation, the reasons Vishal Parekar

which weighed this Court in granting the interim bail to the applicants and the core question which would arise for adjudication at the trial, further custodial interrogation of the applicants does not seem warranted.
8.
I am, therefore, inclined to make the orders of interim bail absolute.
Hence, the following order.
